column1: # [OPUS-4.8] LUBM(1) per-commit expected solution counts (count mode = solution count), split
# by reasoning regime. Deterministic at gen.sh's fixed (-univ 1 -seed 0) corpus, so a row-count
# drift = a correctness regression (engine OR reasoner). Format: <query>\t<rows>\t<regime>.
#   extensional  measured against the RAW LUBM(1) ABox (no ontology, no entailment).
#   entailed     measured against the OWL-RL closure of (ABox + Univ-Bench TBox), i.e. after
#                `sparq-cli reason ... owl`. These ALL return 0 on the raw data — the whole
#                point of the suite is the entailment delta (see the "raw" column below).
# REASONING DELTA (entailed query result on RAW data -> on OWL closure), the suite's raison
# d'etre — every entailed query goes from EMPTY to its correct count once the closure exists:
# Which OWL feature each entailed query exercises (see the per-query .rq headers):
#   q06 OWL restriction class (Student)    q07 Student closure
#   q08 Student closure                    q09 Student + Faculty closure
#   q12 OWL defined-class Chair + transitive  q13 owl:inverseOf (hasAlumnus) + subClassOf
# NOTE: RDFS-only reasoning is INCOMPLETE for this suite — it under-counts q06/q08 (misses
# GraduateStudent subset of Student, which is an OWL restriction inference) and returns 0 for
# q10/q11/q12/q13. run.sh therefore materializes the OWL-RL closure for the entailed tier.
